code.text: Dental encounter summary — to referring teledentistry provider

assessor.display: Dr. Priya Nair, DDS — Barton Springs Dental Group

summary: Sarah Okonkwo seen 2026-07-15 per referral from Meridian Teledental (Dr. Webb). Periapical radiograph confirmed irreversible pulpitis with periapical abscess, tooth #19. Root canal therapy completed in a single visit (D3330): three canals instrumented and obturated. Patient tolerated the procedure well. Final restoration (crown) indicated; patient advised to contact her regular dental provider. Follow-up periapical radiograph recommended at 6 months. Ibuprofen 400 mg PRN for post-operative discomfort.

note.text: Structured encounter summary returned to the referring teledentistry provider (Dr. Webb, Meridian Teledental) via Da Vinci CDex provider-to-provider push — a single recipient (the originating provider), unlike UC03's two-recipient fan-out. This summary closes the referral loop (see the completed referral Task and ServiceRequest). Transmitted as discrete FHIR, not a PDF. The in-office radiograph itself is not re-transmitted; its conclusion is carried here via the referenced DiagnosticReport.
